notes.title: Factory Update & The Future
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

Today we bring you a new area and some updates on what we've been up to. 

[h1]THE FACTORY[/h1]
This is the new area that somehow took 8 months to complete. It has 10 levels and is in between the cave and snow areas.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551027/6bbe6e3d7607efed9bb3e111008ae90fdd8118da.png[/img]

[h1]Retropalooza[/h1]
I am going to be at a convention called Retropalooza in Arlington, Texas on October 23rd-24th. The tickets are relatively cheap and I would love to meet you all! You can find more information about Retropalooza [url=https://retropalooza.com]here.[/url] I'm going to be showcasing Pulse Jumper as well as a secret project that I started on recently.

[h1]The Future of Pulse Jumper.[/h1]
Seeing as up to this point, Pulse Jumper hasn't really taken off like I hoped, I'm going to be taking a break from it and work on other things. But, if it does take off and there's demand for me to work on it, then I'll come back.

Thanks for reading and sticking around,

Ben

notes.title: General Hotfix
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

I have just applied a hotfix to the demo build of Pulse Jumper. We were getting a lot of reports of getting stuck on walls and games crashing because of it. This has been fixed and there are now some features that were only intended for the final release but were kept in the demo because they improved the overall feel of the game.

If you find any more bugs or would just like to chat, make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/gTeBk5ccra]Discord server![/url]
